grad.name: GR
grad.rule: GR (revised 21 Oct 09:47 UK): thin graduations - under 156 buyers, graduated 10-185 s after launch - bought on the new pool; sold if the price 10 s after the buy is below the buy price, else at 3 min (floor 1.3x once 1.5x is seen, stop below 0.6x). A live book that loses over its last 20 live legs goes back to shadow by itself.

asoc.name: AS
asoc.rule: AS: A's trigger with the owner's standard filters - socials not known to be missing, the creator has not bought and sold out, the biggest buyer in the trigger minute put in 3-5 SOL · runner exit. The best paper book (+11.5% a trade on 78 to 21 Oct 00:59 UK); shadow measures its real fills before any money goes in
